responsibility: Implements the floating-point side of GCC’s range-operator framework used by ranger and value-range propagation. It provides default and specialized handlers for folding floating-point unary, binary, and relational operations over frange operands, tracks NaN, infinity, signed-zero, denormal, and trapping-math behavior, and populates the floating_op_table that dispatches tree codes like PLUS_EXPR, RDIV_EXPR, and comparisons to the correct floating range semantics.
